name: Kobayashi Masami
source:
The manager of a karaoke bar, she takes her job extremely serious. Because of that, she's been put in charge of the Shinjuku branch at the young age of 24.

When she’s working, she has a certain aloofness about her. She also sometimes speaks to others in a commanding tone. Her sparkling, sidelong glances have an intimidating power.

When it comes to sex, given her appearance and demeanor, she might appear to be the dominant type... but in reality, she's the submissive type.

She acts aloof during the day, but when it comes to nighttime activities, she becomes completely affectionate and clingy.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/366945/]Getchu[/url]]
